tool.name: ForexVPS
tool.description: ForexVPS rents Windows servers so MetaTrader and other platforms can stay online when your own computer is off. Plans differ by CPU, memory and how many platforms they suggest you run.
features: Windows Server with a dedicated IP and 22 locations
One-click MetaTrader install and remote desktop access
A trade copier is included with the VPS plans

plans.name: Core
plans.detail: Or $28.80/mo billed at $345.60 per year. 2 CPU, 4 GB RAM, 100 GB. Suggested for 1 to 2 platforms.

plans.name: Edge
plans.detail: Or $43.20/mo billed at $518.40 per year. 4 CPU, 6 GB RAM, 150 GB.

plans.name: Prime
plans.detail: Or $57.60/mo billed at $691.20 per year. 6 CPU, 8 GB RAM, 200 GB.

plans.name: Dedicated server
plans.detail: Custom dedicated hardware. GPU servers were listed from $640/mo.
